edge.topo_cache_loaded.text: loaded the topology from the local cache nodes:%d updated_at:%d
edge.topo_cache_loaded.note: KeyTopoCacheLoaded is the key used after the topology was loaded from the cache file, with the node count and the cache write instant in Unix seconds as arguments

edge.probe_port_unset.text: probe_port is not configured, skipping the probe service (fakeip-only or icmp mode)
edge.probe_port_unset.note: KeyProbePortUnset is the key used when the probe service is skipped because probe_port is 0, and it carries no argument

edge.probe_icmp_no_listener.text: probe_proto is icmp, so no probe listener is started (the client pings this host's IP directly)
edge.probe_icmp_no_listener.note: KeyProbeICMPNoListener is the key used when no listener is started because probe_proto is icmp, and it carries no argument

edge.probe_tcp_listen_failed.text: TCP probe port listen failed err:%v
edge.probe_tcp_listen_failed.note: KeyProbeTCPListenFailed is the key used when the TCP probe port fails to listen, whose argument is the listen error

edge.probe_tcp_listening.note: KeyProbeTCPListening is the key used once the TCP probe port listens, whose argument is the listen address

edge.probe_tcp_rate_limited.text: TCP probe request over the per-IP rate limit, rejected remote:%s
edge.probe_tcp_rate_limited.note: KeyProbeTCPRateLimited is the key used when a TCP probe request exceeds the per-source-IP rate limit, whose argument is the source host

edge.probe_tcp_gate_full.text: TCP probe concurrency is full, rejected remote:%s
edge.probe_tcp_gate_full.note: KeyProbeTCPGateFull is the key used when the TCP probe concurrency gate is full, whose argument is the source host

edge.probe_udp_listen_failed.text: UDP probe port listen failed err:%v
edge.probe_udp_listen_failed.note: KeyProbeUDPListenFailed is the key used when the UDP probe port fails to listen, whose argument is the listen error

edge.probe_udp_listening.note: KeyProbeUDPListening is the key used once the UDP probe port listens, whose argument is the listen address

edge.center_connect_attempt.note: KeyCenterConnectAttempt is the key printed before every Center connection attempt, with the current attempt number and the total as arguments

edge.center_connect_failed.note: KeyCenterConnectFailed is the key used when connecting to Center fails, whose argument is the connection error

edge.center_wait_registration_failed.text: waiting for the Center registration result failed err:%v
edge.center_wait_registration_failed.note: KeyCenterWaitRegistrationFailed is the key used when waiting for the registration result fails during start-up, whose argument is the wait error

edge.center_rejected_stop_startup_retry.text: Center rejected the registration and stop_reconnect_on_reject is true, stopping the start-up retries
edge.center_rejected_stop_startup_retry.note: KeyCenterRejectedStopStartupRetry is the key used when the start-up retries stop because registration was rejected and the switch asks for it, and it carries no argument

edge.secret_loaded_from_cache.text: shared_secret loaded from the cache, so degraded mode can sign Tokens
edge.secret_loaded_from_cache.note: KeySecretLoadedFromCache is the key used when degraded mode obtained a shared_secret from the cache, and it carries no argument

edge.secret_missing_in_cache.text: the cache holds no shared_secret, so degraded mode cannot sign Tokens (a normal connection to Center has to happen first)
edge.secret_missing_in_cache.note: KeySecretMissingInCache is the key used when the cache holds no shared_secret, and it carries no argument

edge.enter_degraded_mode.text: Center is unreachable or rejected the registration, the local cache has been loaded and the node enters degraded mode
edge.enter_degraded_mode.note: KeyEnterDegradedMode is the key used when the retries are exhausted and the node enters degraded mode after loading the local cache, and it carries no argument

edge.started_degraded.text: Edge started in degraded mode and waits for Center to reconnect...
edge.started_degraded.note: KeyStartedDegraded is the key used once the services are up while the node is in degraded mode, and it carries no argument

edge.started_normal.note: KeyStartedNormal is the key used once the services are up with a Center connection in place, and it carries no argument

edge.shutting_down.note: KeyShuttingDown is the key used when ctx ends and the node starts shutting down, and it carries no argument

edge.background_reconnect_attempt.text: reconnecting to Center in the background...
edge.background_reconnect_attempt.note: KeyBackgroundReconnectAttempt is the key printed before every background reconnect in degraded mode, and it carries no argument

edge.background_reconnect_failed.note: KeyBackgroundReconnectFailed is the key used when the background reconnect fails to dial, whose argument is the connection error

edge.background_reconnect_wait_failed.text: the background reconnect failed while waiting for the registration result err:%v
edge.background_reconnect_wait_failed.note: KeyBackgroundReconnectWaitFailed is the key used when the background reconnect fails while waiting for the registration result, whose argument is the wait error

edge.center_rejected_stop_background_rec.text: Center rejected the registration and stop_reconnect_on_reject is true, stopping the background reconnect
edge.center_rejected_stop_background_rec.note: KeyCenterRejectedStopBackgroundReconnect is the key used when the background reconnect stops because registration was rejected and the switch asks for it, and it carries no argument

edge.left_degraded_mode.text: reconnected to Center and left degraded mode
edge.left_degraded_mode.note: KeyLeftDegradedMode is the key used when the background reconnect succeeded and the node left degraded mode, and it carries no argument

edge.link_status_changed.text: link status changed from:%s to:%s loss_rate:%v threshold:%v
edge.link_status_changed.note: KeyLinkStatusChanged is the key used when the link status transitions, with the previous status, the new status, the windowed loss rate and the configured threshold as arguments

edge.fake_ip_self_address_skipped.text: this FAKE-IP equals the host's own address and was skipped ip:%s
edge.fake_ip_self_address_skipped.note: KeyFakeIPSelfAddressSkipped is the key used when a FAKE-IP is skipped for being this node's own address, whose argument is that FAKE-IP

edge.write_to_center_failed.note: KeyWriteToCenterFailed is the key used when writing a message on the control-plane connection fails, whose argument is the write error

edge.write_queue_full.text: the write queue is full, dropping the Center connection to trigger a reconnect type:%s
edge.write_queue_full.note: KeyWriteQueueFull is the key used when the write queue is full and the current connection is dropped for it, whose argument is the message type that triggered the drop

edge.center_connection_lost.text: the Center connection dropped on a read error err:%v
edge.center_connection_lost.note: KeyCenterConnectionLost is the key used when reading the control-plane connection fails, whose argument is the read error. The message goes out before the reconnect decision, so its text states nothing about whether a reconnect follows; the outcome is reported by the KeyRejectedStopAutoReconnect or KeyTryingReconnect line that comes next

edge.rejected_stop_auto_reconnect.text: registration was rejected by Center and stop_reconnect_on_reject is true, so no automatic reconnect is started
edge.rejected_stop_auto_reconnect.note: KeyRejectedStopAutoReconnect is the key used when no automatic reconnect starts because registration was rejected and the switch is true, and it carries no argument

edge.registered_payload_parse_failed.note: KeyRegisteredPayloadParseFailed is the key used when the registration result payload fails to parse, whose argument is the parse error

edge.registration_rejected.text: Center rejected the registration uuid:%s reason:%s
edge.registration_rejected.note: KeyRegistrationRejected is the key used when Center rejects the registration, with this node's UUID and the reason as arguments

edge.reject_reason_payload_invalid.text: the registration payload is not valid JSON
edge.reject_reason_payload_invalid.note: KeyRejectReasonPayloadInvalid is the text of the payload_invalid reason code

edge.reject_reason_fields_invalid.text: a registration field failed its range check
edge.reject_reason_fields_invalid.note: KeyRejectReasonFieldsInvalid is the text of the fields_invalid reason code

edge.reject_reason_rate_limited.text: the registration rate of this UUID is over its limit
edge.reject_reason_rate_limited.note: KeyRejectReasonRateLimited is the text of the rate_limited reason code

edge.reject_reason_capacity_reached.text: the number of online Edges has reached its cap
edge.reject_reason_capacity_reached.note: KeyRejectReasonCapacityReached is the text of the capacity_reached reason code

edge.reject_reason_unknown.text: Center rejected the registration with an unknown reason code:%s
edge.reject_reason_unknown.note: KeyRejectReasonUnknown is the key used for a reason code this build does not know, whose argument is that code

edge.registration_succeeded.note: KeyRegistrationSucceeded is the key used after a successful registration, whose argument is this node's UUID

edge.topo_response_parse_failed.text: parsing TopoResponse failed, keeping the previous topology err:%v
edge.topo_response_parse_failed.note: KeyTopoResponseParseFailed is the key used when the topology response fails to parse, whose argument is the parse error. The previous topology stays in place on such a failure, so only this error is recorded here

edge.topology_updated.note: KeyTopologyUpdated is the key used after the topology was replaced, with the node count and the client-info collection switch of Center as arguments

edge.secret_push_parse_failed.text: parsing SecretPushPayload failed, keeping the previous secret err:%v
edge.secret_push_parse_failed.note: KeySecretPushParseFailed is the key used when the secret push payload fails to parse, whose argument is the parse error. The previous secret stays in place on such a failure, so only this error is recorded here

edge.secret_push_invalid.text: the secret in SecretPushPayload is invalid and the push is ignored err:%v len:%d
edge.secret_push_invalid.note: KeySecretPushInvalid is the key used when the pushed secret is invalid, with the hex decoding error and the decoded byte count as arguments. A push that decodes without error but is not 32 bytes long carries a nil error, and the byte count alone then tells the reason

edge.shared_secret_updated.note: KeySharedSecretUpdated is the key used after a secret push was received and accepted, whose argument is the pushed version

edge.unknown_message_type.note: KeyUnknownMessageType is the key used when a downstream message type is not recognised, whose argument is that message type

edge.center_rejected_stop_reconnect.text: Center rejected the registration and stop_reconnect_on_reject is true, stopping the reconnect
edge.center_rejected_stop_reconnect.note: KeyCenterRejectedStopReconnect is the key used when the reconnect stops because registration was rejected and the switch asks for it, and it carries no argument

edge.trying_reconnect.note: KeyTryingReconnect is the key printed before every reconnect attempt dials, and it carries no argument

edge.business_port_listening.note: KeyBusinessPortListening is the key used once the business port listens, whose argument is the listen address

edge.business_accept_failed.note: KeyBusinessAcceptFailed is the key used when the business port Accept fails, whose argument is the accept error

edge.business_listen_failed.note: KeyBusinessListenFailed is the key used when the business port fails to listen, with the listen address and the listen error as arguments. The caller treats it as a normal exit, so the text names the listening step as the one that failed

edge.first_packet_short_prefix.text: fewer than 4 bytes were read, so the frame length cannot be parsed
edge.first_packet_short_prefix.note: KeyFirstPacketShortPrefix is the key used when the prefix handed over by the classification stage is shorter than 4 bytes, and it takes no argument. The branch needs a prefix shorter than the frame length field, which the caller is expected not to hand over

edge.first_packet_over_limit.note: KeyFirstPacketOverLimit is the key used when the frame length declared by the business first frame exceeds util.MaxFrameSize, whose argument is that length. The check runs before the payload is read, so the buffer allocated for the frame body stays within 1 MB

edge.first_packet_prefix_overflow.text: the data carried by alreadyRead exceeds the frame length: got=%d, frameLen=%d
edge.first_packet_prefix_overflow.note: KeyFirstPacketPrefixOverflow is the key used when the data carried by the read prefix exceeds the frame length, with the frame body byte count inside the prefix and the frame length as arguments. The branch is pure defensive code, because neither the 4-byte nor the 16-byte handoff of classifyConnection reaches it

edge.registration_flow_not_started.text: the registration flow has not started yet
edge.registration_flow_not_started.note: KeyRegistrationFlowNotStarted is the key used when the registration result cannot be awaited because Connect has not run, and it takes no argument. regCh is nil while Connect has not run, which leaves nothing to wait on

edge.registration_conn_closed.text: the connection is closed and no registration result arrived
edge.registration_conn_closed.note: KeyRegistrationConnClosed is the key used when the connection closes before the registration result arrives, and it takes no argument

edge.registration_wait_timeout.text: timed out waiting for the registration result
edge.registration_wait_timeout.note: KeyRegistrationWaitTimeout is the key used when waiting for the registration result times out, and it takes no argument

edge.degraded_no_cache_dir.text: connecting to the Center failed and no topology cache directory (topo_cache_dir) is configured
edge.degraded_no_cache_dir.note: KeyDegradedNoCacheDir is the key used when the retries are exhausted and no topology cache directory is configured, and it takes no argument. The branch fails before degraded mode, since without a cache directory there is no local topology to load

edge.degraded_no_usable_cache.text: connecting to the Center failed and no usable local cache is available: %w
edge.degraded_no_usable_cache.note: KeyDegradedNoUsableCache is the key used when the retries are exhausted and the local cache is unusable, whose argument is the cache loading error

edge.handshake_concurrency_full.text: the concurrency cap of unauthenticated and bootstrap handshakes is full, rejecting the new connection
edge.handshake_concurrency_full.note: KeyHandshakeConcurrencyFull is the key used when the concurrency gate of unauthenticated and bootstrap handshakes is full, and it carries no argument

edge.bootstrap_rate_limited.text: [%s] bootstrap request over the rate limit, rejected
edge.bootstrap_rate_limited.note: KeyBootstrapRateLimited is the key used when a bootstrap request exceeds the per-source-IP rate limit, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.bootstrap_degraded_mode.text: [%s] bootstrapping the client in degraded mode with the cached topology
edge.bootstrap_degraded_mode.note: KeyBootstrapDegradedMode is the key used when a client is bootstrapped while the node is degraded, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.bootstrap_no_probe_items.note: KeyBootstrapNoProbeItems is the key used when the topology yields no probe item at all, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.bootstrap_send_list_failed.text: [%s] sending the probe item list failed err:%v
edge.bootstrap_send_list_failed.note: KeyBootstrapSendListFailed is the key used when sending the probe item list fails, with the remote address and the write error as arguments

edge.bootstrap_read_results_failed.text: [%s] reading the probe results failed err:%v
edge.bootstrap_read_results_failed.note: KeyBootstrapReadResultsFailed is the key used when reading the client probe results fails, with the remote address and the read error as arguments

edge.bootstrap_parse_results_failed.text: [%s] parsing the probe results failed err:%v
edge.bootstrap_parse_results_failed.note: KeyBootstrapParseResultsFailed is the key used when the probe results fail to parse, with the remote address and the parse error as arguments

edge.bootstrap_result_count_abnormal.text: [%s] unexpected number of probe results results:%d items:%d
edge.bootstrap_result_count_abnormal.note: KeyBootstrapResultCountAbnormal is the key used when the probe result count exceeds the number of items sent, with the remote address, the result count and the item count as arguments

edge.bootstrap_rtt_rejected.text: [%s] dropping an abnormal RTT code:%s rtt_ms:%d
edge.bootstrap_rtt_rejected.note: KeyBootstrapRTTRejected is the key used when an RTT in the probe results is negative or above the trusted bound and is dropped, with the remote address, the code and the RTT in milliseconds as arguments

edge.bootstrap_all_overloaded.text: [%s] no candidate node is outside the overloaded state, falling back to the overloaded nodes
edge.bootstrap_all_overloaded.note: KeyBootstrapAllOverloaded is the key used when the filtering leaves no candidate and the overloaded nodes are used as a fallback, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.bootstrap_no_candidate.note: KeyBootstrapNoCandidate is the key used when even the overloaded nodes yield nothing, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.bootstrap_token_failed.note: KeyBootstrapTokenFailed is the key used when issuing the route Token fails, with the remote address and the issuing error as arguments

edge.bootstrap_send_redirect_failed.text: [%s] sending the Redirect command failed err:%v
edge.bootstrap_send_redirect_failed.note: KeyBootstrapSendRedirectFailed is the key used when sending the Redirect command fails, with the remote address and the write error as arguments

edge.bootstrap_completed.note: KeyBootstrapCompleted is the key used once one bootstrap interaction is done, with the remote address, the target node UUID and the total path RTT in milliseconds as arguments

edge.business_read_first_packet_failed.text: [%s] reading the first packet failed err:%v
edge.business_read_first_packet_failed.note: KeyBusinessReadFirstPacketFailed is the key used when reading the business first frame fails, with the remote address and the read error as arguments

edge.business_first_packet_json_failed.text: [%s] parsing the first packet JSON failed
edge.business_first_packet_json_failed.note: KeyBusinessFirstPacketJSONFailed is the key used when the business first frame fails to parse as JSON, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.business_client_addr_failed.text: [%s] the client address cannot be resolved
edge.business_client_addr_failed.note: KeyBusinessClientAddrFailed is the key used when the remote address of the connection cannot be asserted as a TCP address, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.business_token_rejected.text: [%s] Token verification failed, dropping the connection
edge.business_token_rejected.note: KeyBusinessTokenRejected is the key used when the route Token fails verification, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.business_forward_cap_reached.text: [%s] the established forwarding connections reached the cap, rejecting the connection
edge.business_forward_cap_reached.note: KeyBusinessForwardCapReached is the key used when the established forwarding connections reach the cap, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.business_write_ack_failed.text: [%s] writing the verification acknowledgement failed err:%v
edge.business_write_ack_failed.note: KeyBusinessWriteAckFailed is the key used when writing the verification acknowledgement to the client fails, with the remote address and the write error as arguments

edge.business_dial_origin_failed.note: KeyBusinessDialOriginFailed is the key used when dialling the origin fails, with the remote address and the dial error as arguments

edge.business_local_addr_failed.text: [%s] the local address cannot be resolved
edge.business_local_addr_failed.note: KeyBusinessLocalAddrFailed is the key used when the local address cannot be asserted as a TCP address, whose first argument is the remote address

edge.business_write_comm_secret_failed.text: [%s] writing the communication secret failed err:%v
edge.business_write_comm_secret_failed.note: KeyBusinessWriteCommSecretFailed is the key used when writing the communication secret to the origin fails, with the remote address and the write error as arguments

edge.business_write_ppv2_failed.text: [%s] writing the PPv2 header failed err:%v
edge.business_write_ppv2_failed.note: KeyBusinessWritePPv2Failed is the key used when writing the PPv2 header to the origin fails, with the remote address and the write error as arguments

edge.business_read_server_ack_failed.text: [%s] reading the Server ack frame failed err:%v (is the Server Agent version too old?)
edge.business_read_server_ack_failed.note: KeyBusinessReadServerAckFailed is the key used when reading the Server Agent ack frame fails, with the remote address and the read error as arguments

edge.business_server_ack_parse_failed.text: [%s] parsing the Server ack frame failed err:%v
edge.business_server_ack_parse_failed.note: KeyBusinessServerAckParseFailed is the key used when the Server Agent ack frame fails to parse, with the remote address and the parse error as arguments

edge.business_relay_established.text: [%s] L4 relay established origin:%s client_v:%s server_v:%s
edge.business_relay_established.note: KeyBusinessRelayEstablished is the key used once the bidirectional L4 relay is up, with the remote address, the origin address, the client version and the Server Agent version as arguments

logx.queue_full.note: KeyQueueFull is the key of the notice printed when the log queue is full and drops records. The notice goes out once before the first record of that batch and carries the number of records dropped

protocol.ppv2_header_too_short.note: KeyPPv2HeaderTooShort is the key used when the argument is shorter than PPv2MinHeaderLen, with the argument length and that lower bound as arguments. The check runs first, which lets every later branch that indexes into the header read the complete minimum header

protocol.ppv2_signature_mismatch.text: the PPv2 signature check failed at position %d
protocol.ppv2_signature_mismatch.note: KeyPPv2SignatureMismatch is the key used when the 12-byte signature comparison fails, whose argument is the first index that differs

protocol.ppv2_command_unsupported.note: KeyPPv2CommandUnsupported is the key used when the command byte is not 0x21, whose argument is that byte

protocol.ppv2_ipv4_length_mismatch.text: the IPv4 header length field does not match: %d != 12
protocol.ppv2_ipv4_length_mismatch.note: KeyPPv2IPv4LengthMismatch is the key used when the address length field of an IPv4 header is not 12, whose argument is the value of that field

protocol.ppv2_ipv4_header_too_short.text: the IPv4 header is too short: %d < %d
protocol.ppv2_ipv4_header_too_short.note: KeyPPv2IPv4HeaderTooShort is the key used when the argument is shorter than PPv2HeaderLenIPv4, with the argument length and that complete header length as arguments

protocol.ppv2_ipv6_length_mismatch.text: the IPv6 header length field does not match: %d != 36
protocol.ppv2_ipv6_length_mismatch.note: KeyPPv2IPv6LengthMismatch is the key used when the address length field of an IPv6 header is not 36, whose argument is the value of that field

protocol.ppv2_ipv6_header_too_short.text: the IPv6 header is too short: %d < %d
protocol.ppv2_ipv6_header_too_short.note: KeyPPv2IPv6HeaderTooShort is the key used when the argument is shorter than PPv2HeaderLenIPv6, with the argument length and that complete header length as arguments

protocol.ppv2_family_unsupported.note: KeyPPv2FamilyUnsupported is the key used when the address family and transport byte is neither 0x11 nor 0x21, whose argument is that byte

main.config_load_failed.note: KeyConfigLoadFailed is the key used when the configuration cannot be loaded, whose argument is the underlying error

main.config_validate_failed.note: KeyConfigValidateFailed is the key used when the configuration fails validation, whose argument is the underlying error

main.role_unknown.note: KeyRoleUnknown is the key used when self.role names none of the four roles, whose argument is the value read

main.started.note: KeyStarted is the key of the start-up banner, with the build-time version and the running role as arguments

main.shutdown_signal.text: received an exit signal, shutting down...
main.shutdown_signal.note: KeyShutdownSignal is the key used when an exit signal arrives

main.service_exited.text: service exited with an error err:%v
main.service_exited.note: KeyServiceExited is the key used when the role service exits with an error, whose argument is that error

main.lang_unsupported.text: %s=%s is not a supported language tag, falling back to en-US
main.lang_unsupported.note: KeyLangUnsupported is the key used when a language tag is not supported, with the source of the tag and its value as arguments. The source is either --lang or self.lang, so the notice states which one to change

util.frame_too_large.note: KeyFrameTooLarge is the key used when the frame to write exceeds MaxFrameSize, whose argument is the byte count of the argument. The check runs before the header is written, so no byte reaches the connection

util.write_zero_bytes.note: KeyWriteZeroBytes is the key used when a single write reports 0 bytes, and it takes no argument. Treating it as an error keeps the write loop from spinning

util.frame_length_exceeded.note: KeyFrameLengthExceeded is the key used when the frame length read from the connection exceeds MaxFrameSize, whose argument is the value of that length field. The check runs before the payload is read, so the buffer allocated for one frame stays within 1 MB
